cases.observation: Inspected at font_size22, pixel_scale1. The letters remain individually readable, word spaces are immediately distinguishable, and punctuation attaches without merging.
cases.why_acceptable: ON reduces the visibly loose overhang and diagonal starts; baseline marks and the larger i/j dots stay distinguishable at actual small size.
